header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to make Du'a: “(اَللّهُمَّ اَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِيْ فَاَحْسِنْ )خُلُقِيْ O Allah, You have made my outward appearance beautiful! Make my character beautiful too!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ اَقَالَ مُسْلِمًا اَقَالَهُ اللهُ عَثْرَتَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في فضل الاقالة رقم:٣٤٦٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever agrees to take back goods that a Muslim sold or bought, Allah Ta'ala forgives his mistakes.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ اَقَالَ مُسْلِمًا عَثْرَتَهُ اَقَالَهُ اللهُ عَثْرَتَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever forgives the faults of a Muslim, Allah Ta'ala will forgive his faults on the Day of Qiyamah.”

blocks.text: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed, the believers are brothers (to one another)!
